cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a quiet indoor panoramic lift rising through a bright botanical atrium — enjoying the view during a slow ride; her quiet room beside a large home aquarium of green water plants — dangles a pair of strappy high-heeled shoes from two fingers by their straps; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; an empty sunroom with an indoor fabric hammock — enjoying a slow late-morning hammock break; an amusement-park parade street lined with spectators — perched on a ledge or edge; the bridge of a warship of her world — brings a cup to her lips; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; a second-hand book stall under an awning on a quiet street — plays a brass saxophone; an alchemist's potion workshop — holds a small potion bottle of glowing liquid up to the light; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — plays a violin and its bow; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — sweeps the floor beside her with a small hand brush; an open-air flower market — dangles a pair of strappy high-heeled shoes from two fingers by their straps
